items.title: Apple stock slides nearly 10% as Cook warns of memory shortage impact
items.summary: Apple reported its Q3 earnings on Thursday.

items.title: Apple stock plunges: CEO Tim Cook explains weak revenue forecast
items.summary: Apple (AAPL) stock is moving lower after the company's revenue forecast fell short of Wall Street's expectations. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley chats with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi about what's driving the stock and guidance lower.

items.title: Apple is growing without the AI spending spree engulfing Big Tech: Chart of the Day
items.summary: Apple is growing like an AI spender but isn't spending like one. Thursday's earnings show that route may be cheaper — but it's not free of obstacles.

items.title: Apple commits more than $30 billion to US manufacturing
items.summary: During Thursday night's earnings call, Apple (AAPL) CEO Tim Cook highlighted a string of milestones, including the company's best-ever June quarter, with revenue reaching $109.4 billion. iPhone revenue surged 22% year-over-year to $54.3 billion, while Mac revenue climbed to a record $10.4 billion. items.title: Investing.com’s stocks of the week
items.summary: Investing.com -- A packed week of Big Tech earnings produced significant moves in both directions, with memory stocks experiencing significant volatility.

items.title: Apple Advances Advertising Gains
items.summary: Apple's services division, which includes advertising, reached a record of $30.7 billion in revenue for Q3 2026, up 12% year-over-year. Ads were a key growth driver supporting App Store and Music, but services slightly missed analyst estimates of $31.2 billion.
